line.en: kick-off 20:30, friday night. every screen is on the match; come at 20:00 for a table before the pubs fill.
line.de: anstoß 20:30, freitagabend. alle bildschirme zeigen das spiel; komm um 20:00 für einen tisch, bevor es voll wird.
line.tr: vuruş 20:30, cuma gecesi. bütün ekranlarda maç var; kalabalıktan önce 20:00'de gel, masa bul.

sparks.why: FC Bayern vs 1. FC Köln, Bundesliga matchday 10, Fri 20.11 20:30 at the Allianz Arena (90min, wettbasis, t-online list the Friday date). Pub spark.

title.en: a short grill at the flaucher.

line.en: cold and dark by half past four. bring sausages and a thermos, grill where the isar allows it and keep it to an hour.
line.de: kalt und ab halb fünf dunkel. würstchen und thermoskanne mit, wo die isar es erlaubt grillen, eine stunde reicht.
line.tr: soğuk ve dörtbuçukta karanlık. sosis ve termos getir, isar izin veren yerde bir saat mangal yap.

sparks.why: No day-specific forecast could be confirmed; late-November Munich, cold, sunset about 16:30 — indoors or short and warm.

line.en: a short climb up the hill, the city flat below and the alps if the air is clear. wear a hat; it is cold up top.
line.de: ein kurzer aufstieg auf den hügel, die stadt flach darunter, bei klarer luft die alpen. mütze auf, oben ist es kalt.
line.tr: tepeye kısa bir tırmanış, aşağıda yassı şehir, hava açıksa alpler. bere tak, yukarısı soğuk.

sparks.why: No day-specific forecast could be confirmed; late-November Munich, cold, sunset about 16:30 — indoors or short and warm.

line.en: sun is up around twenty past seven. be on the steps by seven with something hot; the english garden is quiet before the day starts.
line.de: die sonne geht gegen zwanzig nach sieben auf. um sieben auf den stufen sein, mit etwas heißem; der englische garten ist noch still.
line.tr: güneş yediyi yirmi geçe doğar. yedide basamaklarda ol, yanında sıcak bir şey; ingiliz bahçesi henüz sessiz.

sparks.why: Sunrise in Munich on 20.11 is about 07:20 CET (calendar), so 07:00 start. Weather not confirmed; skip if it is overcast.

line.en: friday is a good day for a late, fat breakfast. fried dough at the frischhut by the viktualienmarkt, hot and a little too sweet.
line.de: freitag ist ein guter tag für ein spätes, fettes frühstück. ausgebackene nudeln im frischhut am viktualienmarkt, heiß und etwas zu süß.
line.tr: cuma geç ve doyurucu bir kahvaltıya uygun. viktualienmarkt yanındaki frischhut'ta sıcak, biraz fazla tatlı hamur kızartması.

sparks.why: Regular Friday, no holiday in Bavaria. Frischhut is the local schmalznudel place; hours not re-checked for today.

title.en: a warm drink above the werksviertel.
title.de: ein warmes getränk über dem werksviertel.

line.en: a rooftop only works dressed for it. blanket, hot wine, the lights coming on over the ostbahnhof; leave when your fingers say so.
line.de: ein dach geht nur warm angezogen. decke, glühwein, die lichter über dem ostbahnhof; geh, wenn die finger es sagen.
line.tr: çatı ancak sıkı giyinince olur. battaniye, glühwein, ostbahnhof üstünde yanan ışıklar; parmakların söyleyince in.

sparks.why: No day-specific forecast could be confirmed; late-November Munich, cold, sunset about 16:30 — indoors or short and warm.

line.en: a jugendstil pool and a sauna floor, warm when the city is not. go in the evening and stay until your fingers wrinkle.
line.de: ein jugendstilbad und eine saunaetage, warm, wenn die stadt es nicht ist. abends hingehen und bleiben, bis die finger schrumpeln.
line.tr: bir jugendstil havuz ve sauna katı, şehir soğukken sıcak. akşam git, parmakların buruşana kadar kal.

sparks.why: Too cold for open water in late November; indoor pool instead. Opening hours for today not confirmed.

title.en: a pub quiz on a friday.

line.en: teams of four, a pencil each, nobody checks your phone. if bayern are on, the quiz waits; ask at the bar what is planned.
line.de: vierer-teams, je ein bleistift, niemand schaut aufs handy. läuft bayern, wartet das quiz; frag an der bar, was geplant ist.
line.tr: dörtlü takımlar, herkese bir kalem, kimse telefona bakmaz. bayern oynuyorsa quiz bekler; barda ne planlandığını sor.

sparks.why: Bayern match at 20:30 competes with quiz nights; no specific quiz event could be confirmed, so it is a generic spark.

title.en: a bar you have never been into.
title.de: eine bar, in der du noch nie warst.

line.en: walk through the glockenbach, pick the door with the warmest window and go in without reading a review.
line.de: lauf durchs glockenbach, nimm die tür mit dem wärmsten fenster und geh rein, ohne eine bewertung zu lesen.
line.tr: glockenbach'ta yürü, penceresi en sıcak olan kapıyı seç ve yorum okumadan gir.

sparks.why: Regular Friday evening; nothing specific confirmed.

title.en: last light at the alter botanischer garten.
title.de: das letzte licht im alten botanischen garten.

line.en: the sun is down by half past four. be there at half past three and shoot the bare trees and the glasshouse while the light is long.
line.de: um halb fünf ist die sonne weg. um halb vier da sein und die kahlen bäume und das glashaus fotografieren, solange das licht lang ist.
line.tr: güneş dörtbuçukta batar. üçbuçukta orada ol, ışık uzunken çıplak ağaçları ve cam serayı çek.

sparks.why: Sunset about 16:30 in Munich on 20.11. Garden is a public park; weather not confirmed.

line.en: the tree at the marienplatz is lit for the first time today and the stalls open. go at six, hold a mug, find the crowd by the rathaus.
line.de: der baum am marienplatz wird heute zum ersten mal angezündet, die buden öffnen. um sechs hin, tasse in der hand, bei den leuten am rathaus stehen.
line.tr: marienplatz'daki ağaç bugün ilk kez yanıyor ve tezgahlar açılıyor. altıda git, elinde bir bardak, rathaus yanındaki kalabalığı bul.

sparks.why: Christkindlmarkt Marienplatz opens Fri 20.11 (muenchen.de), tree lit at the opening, open 10-21. Also Mittelaltermarkt, Residenz market and Winterzauber at Viktualienmarkt start 20.11.

line.en: a private room, a menu of songs and no shame. book for nine, bring people who will sing the second verse with you.
line.de: ein privatraum, eine liste mit liedern und keine scham. für neun reservieren, leute mitbringen, die die zweite strophe mitsingen.
line.tr: özel bir oda, şarkı listesi ve utanma yok. dokuza yer ayır, ikinci kıtayı birlikte söyleyecek insanlar getir.

sparks.why: Regular Friday night; the venue's hours for today were not checked.

title.en: an hour in the record shop.

line.en: flip through the crates at optimal until something looks wrong in a good way. buy one record you cannot name.
line.de: blätter bei optimal durch die kisten, bis etwas auf gute art falsch aussieht. kauf eine platte, deren namen du nicht kennst.
line.tr: optimal'de bir şey iyi anlamda tuhaf görünene kadar kutuları karıştır. adını bilmediğin bir plak al.

sparks.why: Regular Friday, shops open (no holiday); opening hours not rechecked.

line.en: the opening of the christkindlmarkt starts the music: advent songs from the rathaus balcony. stand outside, no ticket, no seat.
line.de: mit der eröffnung des christkindlmarkts beginnt die musik: adventslieder vom rathausbalkon. draußen stehen, kein ticket, kein sitzplatz.
line.tr: christkindlmarkt'ın açılışıyla müzik başlıyor: rathaus balkonundan advent şarkıları. dışarıda dur, bilet yok, koltuk yok.

sparks.why: Christkindlmarkt Marienplatz opens Fri 20.11 (muenchen.de), tree lit at the opening, open 10-21. Music programme includes Advent music from the Rathaus balcony; exact time not confirmed.

title.en: a loop on the isar path.

line.en: from the deutsches museum south to the flaucher on the gravel path, lights on, gloves on, back before it is fully dark.
line.de: vom deutschen museum südwärts bis zum flaucher auf dem kiesweg, licht an, handschuhe an, zurück, bevor es ganz dunkel ist.
line.tr: deutsches museum'dan güneye flaucher'e çakıl yolda, ışık açık, eldiven takılı, tamamen kararmadan dön.

sparks.why: No day-specific forecast could be confirmed; late-November Munich, cold, sunset about 16:30 — indoors or short and warm.

title.en: the late film at the city kino.
title.de: der späte film im city kino.

line.en: friday evening, a small room, a film you did not plan to see. buy popcorn if it is bad, wine if it is good.
line.de: freitagabend, ein kleiner saal, ein film, den du nicht geplant hattest. popcorn, wenn er schlecht ist, wein, wenn er gut ist.
line.tr: cuma akşamı, küçük bir salon, planlamadığın bir film. kötüyse patlamış mısır, iyiyse şarap.

sparks.why: Regular Friday; programme not checked, pick at the door.

title.en: board games and a pot of tea.
title.tr: kutu oyunları ve bir demlik çay.

line.en: bring one game you know and ask for one you do not. a long table beats the cold outside.
line.de: ein spiel mitbringen, das du kennst, und nach einem fragen, das du nicht kennst. ein langer tisch schlägt die kälte draußen.
line.tr: bildiğin bir oyun getir, bilmediğin birini iste. uzun bir masa dışarıdaki soğuktan iyidir.

sparks.why: Regular Friday evening, indoor. Venue hours for today not rechecked.

line.en: three new markets open: residenz, mittelalter and winterzauber at the viktualienmarkt. walk the lot and buy one thing you did not need.
line.de: drei neue märkte öffnen: residenz, mittelalter und winterzauber am viktualienmarkt. alle ablaufen und ein ding kaufen, das du nicht brauchst.
line.tr: üç yeni pazar açılıyor: residenz, mittelalter ve viktualienmarkt'ta winterzauber. hepsini dolaş ve ihtiyacın olmayan bir şey al.

sparks.why: Mittelaltermarkt, Residenz market and Winterzauber at Viktualienmarkt start 20.11 (muenchen.de, muenchen.travel). No regular flea market confirmed today.

line.en: empty paths and floodlights coming on. go early, wear something bright, stop for tea at the stadium.
line.de: leere wege und flutlicht, das angeht. früh hin, etwas helles anziehen, am stadion einen tee trinken.
line.tr: boş yollar ve yanmaya başlayan projektörler. erken git, parlak bir şey giy, stadyumda çay için dur.

sparks.why: No day-specific forecast could be confirmed; late-November Munich, cold, sunset about 16:30 — indoors or short and warm.

title.en: cook from what the market has.

line.en: buy whatever looks best at the viktualienmarkt before it shuts, carry it home and cook for four. no recipe.
line.de: kauf am viktualienmarkt, was am besten aussieht, bevor er schließt, trag es heim und koch für vier. ohne rezept.
line.tr: viktualienmarkt kapanmadan en güzel görüneni al, eve taşı ve dört kişiye pişir. tarifsiz.

sparks.why: Regular Friday, market open. Opening hours for today not rechecked.

line.en: three rounds, cold water between them, no phone. a friday in november is made for this.
line.de: drei gänge, kaltes wasser dazwischen, kein telefon. ein november-freitag ist dafür gemacht.
line.tr: üç tur, arada soğuk su, telefon yok. kasım cuması tam bunun için.

sparks.why: Cold late-November Friday; indoor spark. Opening hours not rechecked.

title.en: an open mic and a loud corner.
title.de: eine offene bühne und eine laute ecke.
title.tr: açık mikrofon ve gürültülü bir köşe.

line.en: sign up at the bar, get five minutes, and be kind to the one before you. a good night is mostly listening.
line.de: an der bar eintragen, fünf minuten bekommen und nett zum vorgänger sein. ein guter abend heißt meistens zuhören.
line.tr: barda kayıt ol, beş dakika al ve senden öncekine nazik ol. iyi bir gece çoğunlukla dinlemektir.

sparks.why: Regular Friday; no specific open mic confirmed for today, check the venue.

line.en: find a table, hold a bat, lose. winner buys the first round, loser the second.
line.de: tisch finden, schläger halten, verlieren. der sieger gibt die erste runde aus, der verlierer die zweite.
line.tr: bir masa bul, raketi tut, kaybet. kazanan ilk turu, kaybeden ikincisini ısmarlar.

sparks.why: Regular Friday evening; indoor venue not specifically confirmed.

line.en: chalk up, pick one route you cannot do and fail at it with friends. the cold is someone else's problem.
line.de: magnesia an die hände, eine route wählen, die du nicht kannst, und mit freunden daran scheitern. die kälte ist ein problem für andere.
line.tr: magnezyumu sür, yapamadığın bir rotayı seç ve arkadaşlarla başarısız ol. soğuk başkasının sorunu.

sparks.why: Indoor climbing hall; Friday evening is busy. Hours not rechecked.

line.en: a flask, bread, cheese and a bench in the sun while it lasts. the sun is gone by half past four, so start early.
line.de: eine thermoskanne, brot, käse und eine bank in der sonne, solange sie da ist. um halb fünf ist sie weg, also früh anfangen.
line.tr: bir termos, ekmek, peynir ve güneş varken bir bank. dörtbuçukta güneş gider, erken başla.

sparks.why: No day-specific forecast could be confirmed; late-November Munich, cold, sunset about 16:30 — indoors or short and warm.

line.en: three bars, one drink each, never more than twenty minutes in one place. end where the lights are still on.
line.de: drei bars, jeweils ein getränk, nie länger als zwanzig minuten am selben ort. dort enden, wo noch licht brennt.
line.tr: üç bar, birer içki, bir yerde yirmi dakikadan fazla kalma. ışıkların hâlâ yandığı yerde bitir.

sparks.why: Bayern match at 20:30 draws many to pubs; crawl is better before or after. No holiday.

line.en: it is dark by five. take a blanket up the hill, let your eyes get used to it and find orion before the cold sends you home.
line.de: ab fünf ist es dunkel. eine decke auf den hügel mitnehmen, die augen gewöhnen lassen und den orion finden, bevor die kälte dich heimschickt.
line.tr: beşte hava kararıyor. tepeye bir battaniye çıkar, gözlerin alışsın ve soğuk seni eve yollamadan orion'u bul.

sparks.why: Dark by 17:00; clear sky not confirmed, so check the forecast before you go.

title.en: friday night football, bayern at home.

line.en: bayern host köln at 20:30 at the allianz arena. no ticket? the kilians and the pubs around it have it on; or play five-a-side at six.
line.de: bayern empfängt köln um 20:30 in der allianz arena. keine karte? das kilians und die pubs ringsum zeigen es; oder um sechs kleinfeld spielen.
line.tr: bayern, köln'ü 20:30'da allianz arena'da ağırlıyor. biletin yok mu? kilians ve çevresindeki pub'lar veriyor; ya da altıda halı saha oyna.

sparks.why: FC Bayern vs 1. FC Köln, matchday 10, Fri 20.11 20:30, Allianz Arena (90min, wettbasis, t-online); Sky broadcast. Cold evening.

title.en: the tram to the end of the line.
title.de: mit der tram bis zur endhaltestelle.

line.en: ride the 17 from the stachus to the last stop and back. window seat, warm inside, the city in lights as the sun goes.
line.de: die 17 vom stachus bis zur letzten haltestelle und zurück. fensterplatz, warm drinnen, die stadt im licht, wenn die sonne geht.
line.tr: 17 numaralıyla stachus'tan son durağa git ve dön. cam kenarı, içerisi sıcak, güneş batarken şehir ışıklarla dolu.

sparks.why: Regular Friday, MVG tram runs; route not rechecked for works.

line.en: a cellar in haidhausen, a trio and a short break after the first set. get there at eight for a seat near the stage.
line.de: ein keller in haidhausen, ein trio und eine kurze pause nach dem ersten set. um acht da sein für einen platz nah an der bühne.
line.tr: haidhausen'da bir mahzen, bir trio ve ilk setten sonra kısa bir mola. sahneye yakın yer için sekizde orada ol.

sparks.why: Unterfahrt is Munich's regular jazz club, music most nights; tonight's programme not confirmed.

title.en: a walk before the light goes.

line.en: from the chinesischer turm to the kleinhesseloher see, in the long afternoon light. the lake is the place to end, a hot drink at the seehaus.
line.de: vom chinesischen turm zum kleinhesseloher see, im langen nachmittagslicht. der see ist ein guter ort zum enden, ein heißes getränk im seehaus.
line.tr: chinesischer turm'dan kleinhesseloher see'ye, uzun öğleden sonra ışığında. göl bitirmek için iyi bir yer, seehaus'ta sıcak bir içki.

sparks.why: No day-specific forecast could be confirmed; late-November Munich, cold, sunset about 16:30 — indoors or short and warm.
